The '''Vollick''' were a species that [[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]] belonged to. This [[Species/Legends|species]] was one of many that inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], and they found themselves constantly battling their [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] neighbors.

This was the species of a very powerful [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] named [[Osika Kirske]], who ruled until [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Kirske was commonly referred to as a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]]; however, this is an incorrect assumption. The Vollick species resembled the appearance of [[Gender/Legends|male]] Rattataki to some extent.
